insurer_name: Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd.
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in urinary and biliary systems
Surgery on skin/tumours/cysts/nodules/polyps including breast lumps
Treatment for benign tumors or malignant conditions or organomegaly

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Day care procedures as listed in Annexure I of policy wordings.

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Plan B only: up to 10% of Sum Insured for treatment exceeding 3 days.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Rs 1,000 per claim for road ambulance.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Plan A: free check-up after every 4 continuous claim-free policy years. Plan B: after every 2 years, 1% of SI or max Rs 5,000.

room_rent_capping: Single Private Air Conditioned room. Optional add-on caps to 1% of SI up to Rs 7,500/day with discount on premium.
copayment_trigger_notes: Plan B: 10% co-payment on every admissible claim. 20% co-payment if treatment at non-network hospital (waivable by paying extra premium).

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: 10% of SI, max Rs 40,000 per claim (whichever lower)

permanent_exclusions: Cosmetic or plastic surgery (except post-accident reconstruction)
Breach of law with criminal intent
Health hydros, nature cure clinics for domestic reasons
Dietary supplements unless prescribed during hospitalization
Refractive error correction less than 7.5 dioptres
War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies
claim_process_summary: Cashless: intimate 48 hours pre-planned hospitalization, 24 hours emergency, request pre-authorization. Reimbursement: documents within 30 days of discharge. Settlement within 30 working days; pre-auth within 120 minutes.
